description: LD-block stratified null analysis for Figure 3 A/B (PONE-D-26-36293 revision). All constants were transferred from the originally executed analysis code (sampler.py MD5 90a0ad89aba97e0b735c074fa9968270; shipped 03_fig3_bootstrap_fdr5.py MD5 d75c7dd6b2a2fa7d8003860eb4616b11; executed notebook sess_bdbf02ac8d9f). No parameter was tuned to match frozen outputs.
genome_build: GRCh37/hg19 (autosomes identical); LDetect EUR blocks and NCBI37.3 gene locations

seed.scheme: numpy.random.SeedSequence(20260527); spawn-key identity makes spawn(6)[i] == spawn(16)[i] for i < 6
seed.block_exact_gps_minus_d_10k: SeedSequence(20260527).spawn(16)[7..11] for T2D, CAD, Hypertension, Asthma, Prostate Ca

cohort.dedup: keep max MAGMA Z per ensembl_id

axes.membership_rule: L2G score >= 0.5 AND parsed diseaseIds intersects axis ID set (disease-membership threshold; distinct from the gPS counting rule)

gps.definition_implemented: uniqueDiseases column of disease_ta_index_pandas.csv (Gentropy), fillna(0); equals the count of distinct diseases per gene in l2g_diseases_full.csv at its native score floor (~0.1), NOT the count at L2G >= 0.5
gps.exact_exclusion_rule: per-gene counted disease sets from l2g_diseases_full.csv exploded without any additional score filter; gPS^(-d)_i = |D_i \ axis_ids|, clipped at 0; bins and per-bin gene-count targets rebuilt; 10,000 replicates per axis

ld_blocks.source: Berisa & Pickrell (2016) LDetect EUR partition, fourier_ls-all.bed, bitbucket.org/nygcresearch/ldetect-data
ld_blocks.gene_assignment: midpoint of the MAGMA window (gene_annotation_table start/stop ARE the 35 kb upstream / 10 kb downstream window bounds); nearest-block fallback within 1 Mb across gaps; 100% of 7,707 universe genes assigned

sampler.binning: blocks binned by mean log2(gPS+1) of their pool genes, assigned to nearest risk-set integer-gPS bin in log2(gPS+1) space
sampler.crossing_block: unbiased randomized rounding: include crossing block with probability (target - achieved)/block_size
sampler.neighbour_borrowing: only on supply exhaustion, from nearest bin(s) in log2(gPS+1) space; single crossing decision across the borrow sequence

p_value: p = min(1, 2*min(b_le+1, b_ge+1)/(B+1)); floor 2e-4 at B=10,000; never 0
fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg across the 5 primary axes, computed separately within each specification (q_BH5); exploratory axes excluded from the primary family
mc_intervals: Clopper-Pearson 95% interval on min(b_le, b_ge)/B propagated through the p formula and the BH step (p_mc_lo/hi, q_BH5_mc_lo/hi)
